description: Least privilege for a window on one Markdown file the system handed to Thoth (file-*, ADR-0057): it reads and writes that file through its token (opened-*), closes itself, opens the file's folder as a Private Space (file-promote, which the shell checks), listens for events, zooms and follows the theme. No vault, fs, sql, agent, server, update, module, Connected apps or diagnostics command.
